## Reviews24 Results

5.0Rating: 5 out of 5 based on 24 reviews

[Write a review](https://www.ticketmaster.com/review?attractionId=1724038)

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Leprous @ Somerville

by Jross on 5/13/25Somerville Theatre \- Somerville



Leprous celebrated the 10th anniversary of the album “The Congregation by performing the album in Its entirety. Einar’s voice was spot on as always and the band was was super tight as always. If you are a progressive rock or just a rock fan in general you are missing out if you haven’t heard or seen them live.

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Amazing show!

by Snowy on 5/13/25Somerville Theatre \- Somerville



We’ve seen Leprous several times and they’re always great. This was the last show of the US tour and the band was ON FIRE! They tore through the entire Congregation album with a vengeance, then treated us to some extra tracks as well. These guys are always technically flawless, but the energy of the Boston audience on this night was palpable, and the band was feeling that love. Best Leprous show we’ve seen to date.

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Yes LEPROUS Yes !!!

by Mathematical on 5/10/25Théâtre Beanfield \- Montreal



excellent show !!! Expectations totally blown by the quaility of the live performance. Leprous are true pros and have such a good vibe together on stage !!!

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Love watching Leprous on stage, very active.

by Lady M on 4/25/25



This was my second time seeing Leprous with Wheel and I loved the show. I am a big fan of Leprous before seeing them in concert and I was really happy they toured here. Will definitely see them live again.

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Blown away

by Amanda on 4/22/25The Regent Theater \- Los Angeles



Leprous blew the roof off the place! Incredibly talented, humble, friendly, fantastic band. They are extremely fantastic live, I highly recommend seeing them if you get the chance.
🤘🏼🖤

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Incredible preformance

by IronShark on 4/22/25Ace of Spades \- Sacramento



This was my first time seeing Leprous live, became a fan of theirs recently when I discovered some of their music. Wow. What a performance that was! So happy I went out too see them. Absolutely one of my favorite shows I’ve been to in a while!

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Leprous is Mind-Blowing!

by Nick on 4/21/25The Regent Theater \- Los Angeles



Leprous is a band that I would highly recommend to anybody, even if their genre isn’t what you normally listen to. They put on an incredible show and the musicianship is incredible. And the lead vocalist is insanely talented, melodic, and brings great energy to the stage. LOVED THIS SHOW!

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### The best of what they had

by Mic2.0 on 4/16/25Delmar Hall \- Saint Louis



Wheel put on a great opening act! Leprous started off as expected but quickly started “scrambling” as the Einar (lead vocalist) confessed he had little-to-no head voice (which is required for his falsetto in so many of his songs). They pulled some old-school (heavy on screaming) metal songs and improvised their way to the last song or two (where they pulled it together to finish with Attonement). It was a solid show though! Hopeful Einar makes a full and quick recovery for the remainder of their tour!

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Stellar show !

by RandomBoi on 4/15/25Bogart's \- Cincinnati



Experiencing leprous live is outstanding. They elevate their songs with their stellar performance. This band sounds TIGHT!

- Rating: 5 out of 5













### Great show...Period

by Pao Esparza on 10/28/24White Oak Music Hall - Downstairs \- Houston



If you like prog music,Leprous is a band you cannot miss live
